question: Who among the following was PETA India's Person of the year 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Virat Kohli.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India captain Virat Kohli was named People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) India’s ‘Person of the Year for 2019’ for his animal advocacy efforts.
 
• The PETA awards are given to people or organisations that take initiative in the welfare of animals and violence against animals.
 
• Past recipients of the award include **Shashi Tharoor, Anushka Sharma, R Madhavan, and Jacqueline Fernandez.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ **

 
• John Abraham has been named the Person of the Year for 2020 by the People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA).

 
 
• John Abraham had sent a letter urging an e-retailer to stop trading in live animals.
 
 

 
• People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) has named Alia Bhatt as its Person of the Year 2021.

 
 
• Alia had also set up a program titled Coexist which is a platform that highlights and works towards the issues of animal and ecological welfare.
